high_level_description: The image is a meme featuring three individuals hugging each other tightly. The person on the left is wearing a red shirt and has their head resting on the shoulder of the person in the middle, who is wearing a blue shirt. The person on the right is wearing a white shirt and has their arm around the shoulders of both the person in the middle and the person on the left. All three individuals appear to be consoling each other. The background shows an urban setting with a brick building and a red wall.
